_why: The PRISMA review in Chapter 4 has a defined scope: seven themed searches over
MEDLINE plus hand-searching, screened to 82 included studies. Those 82 are the
evidence base for claims ABOUT THE LITERATURE.
A thesis also has to cite things that are not review findings: the corpus
descriptor it works on, the reporting guideline it followed, and the second
backbone used for the replication. Those were never candidates for inclusion --
they are not studies of the review question -- so silently adding them to the 82
They live here instead. The bibliography generator reads this file and the
extraction table, numbers both into one reference list, and tags every entry
with the set it came from so Appendix F can state how many of each were cited.
Nothing in this file is typed into the document prose; it is committed data read
by a script, on the same footing as every other artefact.
